answer: For a poll on an onyx vine sculpture's pulse, officials check election-bound signatures against separate frozen rolls of existing and new members. They accept one ballot per listed key, reject invalid or repeated ballots, and pass the proposal only with a majority in each chamber. If 100 existing members vote unanimously against it, passage requires changing at least 51 of their ballots. Rolls may contain sybils, and either chamber can block a popular proposal.
